name: Dwarf
description: Deep in their ancestral halls, dwarves have carved civilization from raw stone for millennia. Masters of dungeon terrain, they read the rock like a map and resist the poisons that fester in its depths. Their stout frames carry heavy armor with ease, making them formidable defenders of the underground.

trait_descriptions.stonecunning: In stone or dungeon zones, the dwarf gains bonus perception, trap detection, and a small combat advantage.
trait_descriptions.poison_resistance: Centuries in toxic depths have granted dwarves significant resistance to poison effects.
